prompts.forest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art background for a cozy RPG character wardrobe preview. Portrait 4:5 composition. Detailed hand-pixelled 16-bit fantasy game environment, crisp visible square pixel clusters, soft dreamy atmosphere, layered depth. Front-facing side-view stage, not an isometric map. Leave the central 45 percent visually quiet behind a large character overlaid in code; character must NOT appear in the image. A continuous grassy or stone ground ledge at 84 percent image height, clear footing with a narrow earth edge; no floating platforms. Upper left open and calm for UI labels. No text, logos, UI, characters or borders. Original environment, no copyrighted game assets. Scene: Cloudwood Forest, a luminous woodland clearing, tall mossy trees frame both edges, hanging warm lanterns, distant lavender treehouses and a small waterfall visible to the right, blue-green foliage, subtle fireflies and sunbeams through a misty canopy. Clear center, gentle sage and aqua tones, peach light.
